name: starlark-phased-hybrid-prototype
description: A bounded Starlark planning experiment with mock and local Claude workers.

scripts.canary: node bin/run-experiment.js --mode live --axis planner --model claude-fable-5 --fault-profile mixed --trace-level full --max-cost-usd 10
scripts.matrix:planner: node bin/run-experiment.js --mode live --axis planner --matrix --fault-profile mixed --trace-level full --max-cost-usd 10
scripts.matrix:worker: node bin/run-experiment.js --mode live --axis worker --matrix --fault-profile mixed --trace-level full --max-cost-usd 10
